payload.title: Community AMD GPU Kernel Optimization
payload.summary: A comprehensive collection of practical knowledge from the Zhihu community on AMD GPU kernel optimization, supplementing the existing documentation in AMD General Optimization Knowledge with community perspectives and hands-on experience.

sections.heading: 1. AMD GPU Kernel Disassembly Analysis Methods
sections.gist: Understanding ISA through disassembly is a key approachhed to AMD GPU optimization.

sections.heading: 3. AMD MoE Kernel Runtime Selection Strategy
sections.gist: The AITER library pre-compiles a large number of hand-written assembly kernels (.co files) for AMD MI300X and other GPUs, automatically selecting the optimal variant at runtime via the `get_heuristic_kernel` function.

sections.heading: 4. RDNA Architecture Optimization Highlights
sections.gist: The RDNA architecture (for gaming/general-purpose computing) differs significantly from CDNA (for AI/HPC), requiring corresponding adjustments to optimization strategies.

sections.heading: 5. CK (Composable Kernel) Template Optimization Practices
sections.gist: CK is the core framework for optimizing GEMM in the AMD ROCm ecosystem, parameterizing all optimization dimensions through C++ template metaprogramming.

sections.heading: 6. MI300X/MI355X Hardware Architecture Essentials
